mapper.select: SELECT h.id, h.userId, h.dishId, h.browseCount, h.lastBrowsedAt, d.dishName, d.description, d.coverImage, d.price FROM browseHistory h JOIN dish d ON d.id = h.dishId WHERE h.userId = #{userId} ORDER BY h.lastBrowsedAt DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO browseHistory (userId, dishId, browseCount, lastBrowsedAt) VALUES (#{userId}, #{dishId}, 1, NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE browseCount = browseCount + 1, lastBrowsedAt = NOW()
